pattern: (/lib/apk/db/lock: Resource temporarily unavailable|apk: could not open database: Permission denied)
explanation: APK lock is held by another running package process or was left behind.

pattern: (not found.*glibc|cannot open shared object file: ld-linux|No such file or directory.*ld-linux)
explanation: Binary compiled against GNU libc cannot run on musl libc without compatibility packages.

remediation: sudo apk update && sudo apk add --no-cache --upgrade {package}
explanation: Package dependency solver encountered unsatisfiable constraints in configured APK repositories.
OpenRC detected that the service daemon PID exited abnormally.
